newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Cenbank, Rio state to decide on Banerj in two days.
newsitem.headline: Cenbank, Rio state to decide on Banerj in two days.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state officials will meet with the Central Bank in the next two days to decide whether state bank Banerj will remain under Central Bank administration, the Rio's Planning Secretary said.
"We will have to evaluate the situation with the Central Bank in the next two days," Marco Aurelio Alencar told a news conference.
He said the Central Bank would also decide whether private investment bank Bozano, Simonsen would continue to manage Banerj on behalf of the Central Bank.
Since early January Banerj has been administered by Bozano, which was hired to run and ready the bank for privatization.
The Central Bank's management of Banerj began in December 1994 and will expire Friday.
Banerj was due to be privatized today but the auction was suspended after a judge ordered the re-evaluation of the bank's assets based on claims by Banerj employees that they were undervalued.
Alencar said he hopes Banerj will be privatized in January as soon as the situation regarding the bank's assets is clarified.
The judge's ruling made it necessary to clarify for interested investors how the minimum price was fixed, he said.
"The fixing of the minimum price was based on the bank's cash flow and not on the bank's asset value," he said.

Alencar said the minimum price of 480 million reais for Banerj and its insurer based on the bank's cash flow was 200 million reais above the bank's asset value. He also said a new tender document would be published clarifying all aspects of the privatization. Banerj was due to be the first Brazilian state bank to be privatized.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5521 5074151))
